;Armed conflicts and attacks
*[[2019 Nairobi attack]]
**Multiple explosions and gunfire are reported after four armed men stormed the Dusit hotel in [[Nairobi]], [[Kenya]]. The Somalia-based militant group [[Al-Shabaab (militant group)|Al-Shabaab]] claims responsibility. [https://www.bbc.com/news/av/world-africa-46881687/nairobi-dusit-hotel-attack-explosions-gunfire-and-rescue-operation (BBC News)]

;Arts and culture
*[[2019 Prayag Kumbh Mela]] 
**The largest human gathering in the world, the [[Kumbh Mela]] festival, starts at [[Prayagraj]] (previously known as Allahabad), India. More than 120 million [[Hindu]] devotees, as well as tourists, are expected. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2019/jan/15/kumbh-mela-hindus-converge-for-largest-ever-human-gathering-prayagraj-festival (''The Guardian'')]

;International relations
*[[North Korea–United States relations]]
**[[South Korea]]n media reports that [[North Korea]]n officials are expected to visit the [[United States]] to discuss a [[2019 North Korea–United States summit|second summit]] between the two countries at an unspecified date. [https://www.reuters.com/video/2019/01/15/north-korean-officials-may-visit-us-this?videoId=503733548&videoChannel=117760&channelName=World+News (Reuters)] [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2019/01/north-korea-hold-talks-week-nuclear-impasse-190115055218069.html (Al Jazeera)]

;Law and crime
*[[Laurent Gbagbo]], former [[President of Ivory Coast]], is acquitted of [[crimes against humanity]] charges by the [[International Criminal Court]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-africa-46875757 (BBC News)]
*[[United States District Court for the Southern District of New York|U.S. District]] judge [[Jesse Furman]] issues a decision that invalidates the Trump administration's addition of a U.S. citizenship question to the [[2020 United States census#Changes|2020 census]]. This is the first ruling on this issue. There are four more lawsuits, filled by dozens of states, cities and other groups, yet to be heard. [https://www.npr.org/2019/01/15/671283852/judge-orders-trump-administration-to-remove-2020-census-citizenship-question (NPR)]
*[[Mossos d'Esquadra|Catalan regional police]] in [[Barcelona]] and [[Igualada]] arrest 17 suspected terrorists ready to launch a terrorist attack. [https://www.telegraph.co.uk/news/2019/01/15/17-suspected-isil-supporters-arrested-spanish-counter-terror/ (''The Telegraph'')] [https://www.europapress.es/catalunya/noticia-mossos-despliegan-operacion-contra-yihadismo-barcelona-igualada-20190115072206.html (Europa Press)]

;Politics and elections
*[[Brexit negotiations]], [[Meaningful vote]] 
**[[Prime Minister of the United Kingdom|British Prime Minister]] [[Theresa May]]'s [[Brexit]] deal is defeated in [[Parliament of the United Kingdom|Parliament]] by [[Meaningful vote|432 votes to 202]], the worst defeat for a Prime Minister in modern [[History of the United Kingdom|British history]]. As a result, a [[2019 motion of no confidence in the May ministry|vote of no confidence in her government]] will be held tomorrow. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-britain-eu/brexit-bedlam-parliament-sinks-pm-mays-eu-divorce-deal-by-230-votes-idUSKCN1P90OU (Reuters)] [https://www.bbc.com/news/uk-politics-46885828 (BBC News)]
*[[2020 United States presidential election]], [[2020 Democratic Party presidential primaries]]
**[[Democratic Party (United States)|Democratic]] [[United States Senate|U.S. Senator]] [[Kirsten Gillibrand]] of [[New York (state)|New York]] announces she is running for [[President of the United States|president]] in 2020. [https://www.npr.org/2019/01/15/678292493/new-york-sen-kirsten-gillibrand-announces-2020-presidential-run (NPR)]  

;Science and technology
*The correction of the [[North Magnetic Pole]] model, one year ahead of the regular five-year update, scheduled to be released this week is delayed until the end of January because of the [[United States federal government shutdown of 2018–2019|U.S. federal government shutdown]].  The model is used in navigation and  by the [[Global Positioning System|GPS]] systems in smartphones. The pole has been wandering, much faster than expected, away from the [[Northern Canada|Canadian Arctic]] toward [[Siberia]]. [https://www.upi.com/Science_News/2019/01/14/Magnetic-Norths-erratic-behavior-forces-update-to-global-navigation-system/1611547434485/ (UPI)] [https://www.technologyreview.com/the-download/612758/the-magnetic-north-pole-is-messing-with-your-smartphones-mapping-apps/ (''M.I.T. Technology Review'')] [https://maritime-executive.com/article/magnetic-north-pole-shifting-rapidly-and-unpredicatably (''The Maritime Executive'')]
